description_compelling: A non-electoral social mobilization with durable identity claims — a religious revival shaping policy, a moral-traditionalist movement reorienting parties, a transnational solidarity wave changing public discourse. Civil-society participation, private-liberty indices, and ethnic-power balance reorient first. Common in mature democracies, in post-secular transitions, and across diaspora-linked political fields.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
